sloka: कथम् दासस्य मे दासी भार्या भवितुम् इच्छसि ।सो अहम् आर्येण परवान् भ्रात्रा कमल वर्णिनी ॥३-१८-९॥
transliteration: katham dāsasya me dāsī bhāryā bhavitum icchasi ।so aham āryeṇa paravān bhrātrā kamala varṇinī ॥3-18-9॥

translations.english: O lotuscomplexioned woman , how can you act as a maid to a slave ? Why do you intend to be so? I am already dependent on my revered brother.
